cards.ex: All her hard work finally started to bear fruit when she got promoted.
cards.exUz: Uning barcha mashaqqatli mehnatlari nihoyat uning lavozimi ko'tarilganda samara bera boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday harakat yoki urinish natijasida yaxshi oqibatlarga erishish.

cards.ex: Having connections in the industry gave him a leg up over other candidates.
cards.exUz: Sanoatda aloqalarga ega bo'lish unga boshqa nomzodlarga nisbatan ustunlik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra yaxshiroq imkoniyatga ega bo'lish yoki imtiyozga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new CEO hit the ground running and immediately implemented changes.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor tezda ishga kirishdi va darhol o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi vaziyatda tez va samarali ishlashni boshlash.

cards.ex: She's a rising star in the company, known for her innovative ideas.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyadagi yuksalayotgan yulduz, o'zining innovatsion g'oyalari bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Tezda muvaffaqiyatga erishayotgan va istiqbolli inson.

cards.ex: Her confidence has grown in leaps and bounds since she started the course.
cards.exUz: U kursni boshlagandan beri uning ishonchi tez o'sdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va katta miqdorda rivojlanish yoki yaxshilanish.

cards.ex: A little encouragement can go a long way in helping someone achieve their goals.
cards.exUz: Ozgina dalda kimdir maqsadlariga erishishga yordam berishda katta yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta foyda keltirmoq yoki muvaffaqiyatga olib kelmoq.

cards.ex: Only the cream of the crop are selected for the national team.
cards.exUz: Faqat eng sara o'yinchilar milliy terma jamoaga tanlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi yoki eng yuqori sifatli narsa yoki insonlar.

cards.ex: His career rocketed to success after he published his first novel.
cards.exUz: Uning birinchi romanini nashr etgandan so'ng, uning faoliyati tezda muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va kutilmaganda muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: She finally achieved recognition for her groundbreaking research.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat o'zining yangi tadqiqotlari uchun tan olindi.
cards.uzDef: Mehnatlari natijasida qadrlanmoq va e'tirof etilmoq.

cards.ex: The company's profits have outstripped expectations this year.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning foydasi bu yil kutilganidan oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidan ancha yaxshiroq natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: She triumphed over personal tragedy to become a successful entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: U shaxsiy fojiani yengib o'tib, muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tish va muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: The team celebrated a resounding victory after winning the championship.
cards.exUz: Jamoa chempionatda g'alaba qozonganidan so'ng qat'iy g'alabani nishonladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va aniq g'alaba, shubhasiz ustunlik.

cards.ex: They sealed the deal with a handshake and a signed contract.
cards.exUz: Ular qo'l siqishib va ​​imzolangan shartnoma bilan kelishuvni tugalladilar.
cards.uzDef: Shartnoma yoki kelishuvni yakunlash va tasdiqlash.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, she's finally in the driver's seat of her own company.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, u nihoyat o'z kompaniyasining boshqaruvida.
cards.uzDef: Nazoratni o'z qo'liga olgan, boshqaruvchi vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Hiring the new CEO was a masterstroke that turned the company around.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktorning yollanishi kompaniyani o'zgartirgan aql bovar qilmas usul edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan juda aqlli harakat.

cards.ex: The scientist attained prominence for her groundbreaking research in genetics.
cards.exUz: Olim genetikadagi yangi tadqiqotlari uchun obro'ga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur, hurmatli va taniqli bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her role in the film catapulted her to international fame.
cards.exUz: Filmda ishtirok etishi uni xalqaro shon-shuhratga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan va tezda mashhurlikka erishish.

cards.ex: We're finally making headway on the project after months of planning.
cards.exUz: Oylik rejalashtirishdan so'ng, biz nihoyat loyiha bo'yicha oldinga siljiyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish yo'lida taraqqiyotga erishish.

cards.ex: Their collaboration proved to be a winning formula for success.
cards.exUz: Ularning hamkorligi muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan g'alaba qozonish usuli ekanligi isbotlandi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan samarali usul yoki yechim.

cards.ex: The band is on the up and up, playing bigger venues every month.
cards.exUz: Guruh yuksalishda, har oyda kattaroq joylarda o'ynashadi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanish, rivojlanish va muvaffaqiyat qozonish holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The athlete reached new heights in his career after years of training.
cards.exUz: Sportchi ko'p yillik mashg'ulotlardan so'ng o'z faoliyatida yangi cho'qqilarga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z imkoniyatlarining eng yuqori darajasiga erishish va undan oshib ketish.

cards.ex: The new product is starting to gain traction in the market.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot bozorda ommaviylasha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaboplik yoki qabul qilinish ortib borishi, e'tibor qozonish.

cards.ex: To her credit, she managed to stay calm under pressure.
cards.exUz: Uning e'tirofga loyiqligi shundaki, u bosim ostida xotirjam qola oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yaxshi fazilatlari yoki yutuqlari e'tirof etilganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: With a brilliant idea and hard work, anyone can soar to success.
cards.exUz: Ajoyib g'oya va mashaqqatli mehnat bilan har kim muvaffaqiyatga erishishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tez va muvaffaqiyatli tarzda yuqoriga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: We need to develop a solid game plan before launching the campaign.
cards.exUz: Biz kampaniyani boshlashdan oldin aniq reja tuzishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun mo'ljallangan batafsil strategiya.

cards.ex: The new technology represents a quantum leap in medical treatment.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya tibbiy davolanishda keskin o'zgarishni anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va muhim o'zgarish yoki taraqqiyot.

cards.ex: Once we get the funding approved, we'll be home and dry.
cards.exUz: Biz moliyalashtirishni tasdiqlaganimizdan so'ng, biz muvaffaqiyatli yakunlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan muvaffaqiyatli chiqish yoki ishni tugatish.

cards.ex: The team is on a winning streak and hopes to continue their success.
cards.exUz: Jamoa omad ketma-ketligida va muvaffaqiyatlarini davom ettirishga umid qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ketma-ket muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish, g'alabalarni qo'lga kiritish.

cards.ex: Investing in education will reap dividends in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan ish yoki sarmoyadan ijobiy natijalar olish.

cards.ex: The company cleared a major hurdle when it secured the contract.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya shartnomani ta'minlaganida katta to'siqdan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilikni yengib o'tish va muvaffaqiyatga erishish.
